text:
Jordan Lee: Morning team, I'm on my first day and running into SSO weirdness. I can sign into Okta but when I try to open Google Drive I get a 403. Okta shows me as 'Provisioned' but not 'Activated'. Anyone seen this flow?

it-support: Hey Jordan, welcome! Can you confirm you clicked the Okta activation link from the welcome email? Sometimes the activation is a separate step from provisioning.

Jordan Lee: I got a welcome email but I don't remember an explicit activation link. The email has links for Slack and 1Password only. My gmail works though (jordan.lee@redwood.ai).

Priya (security): Hi Jordan, we have a SCIM delay window where mail comes through before Drive group membership in some cases. Also we recently tightened MFA device enrollment: YubiKeys require corp-managed enrollment. Are you on a company laptop?

Jordan Lee: Using personal laptop for now, will get my company machine tomorrow. So that explains YubiKey. For 1Password it keeps looping to Okta and then shows 'MFA enrollment required' but when I try to add an authenticator it errors 'enrollment disabled for this device'.

it-support: That matches the device enrollment policy. We can temporarily allow TOTP for onboarding. I'll re-send the activation link and manually add you to the Drive editors group so you have access immediately. Also sending a short-lived 1Password invite that uses email flow.

OnboardBot: Okta activation link resent to jordan.lee@redwood.ai. SCIM sync: created user, drive-editor group pending -> manually added by it-support. 1Password invite created (expires in 24h).

Jordan Lee: Got the activation email now, clicked it and Drive works. 1Password email invite arrived too and TOTP setup finished. Thanks!

Priya (security): We'll catch up tomorrow to register your YubiKey once you're on a corp device. For now keep MFA via TOTP and don't store keys on the personal device. Happy first day! :wave:

it-support: Welcome aboard! If you hit anything else ping #help or DM me.
